title: Rate Card Line Item: Extraction Charge on Partner Cleaning Work Orders
content:
Line item of the Wayfare partner rate card for Cleaning and Damage Fees cleaning reports.

**Rule.** The extraction charge of a partner work order is read from the incident category and the reported trip's actual duration: a food or drink spill or bodily fluids on a trip whose actual duration reached the long-trip minutes takes the deep extraction charge; a food or drink spill or bodily fluids on a shorter trip, or animal hair or mess or smoke or vape odor, takes the surface extraction charge; any other incident takes no extraction charge.

| Incident category on the assessment | Trip's actual duration | Extraction charge |
|---|---|---|
| food or drink spill, or bodily fluids | 30 minutes or more (the long-trip minutes) | $55.00 deep extraction |
| food or drink spill, or bodily fluids | under 30 minutes | $25.00 surface extraction |
| animal hair or mess, or smoke or vape odor | any | $25.00 surface extraction |
| any other incident, such as trash or debris | any | none |

The actual duration is the trip's actual minutes on the trip record in Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares).

The extraction charge is added to the price of the interior service on the work order and forms part of that price.

**Boundary pair (hypothetical).** A bodily fluids work order for a 30-minute trip takes $55.00; for a 29-minute trip it takes $25.00.
